extDescription.message: Open the image you right-click in mImageViewer on this PC, in a window placed over the browser page.

busy.message: An image is being processed. Please wait before trying another image.

success.message: The image was handed to mIV.

interrupted.message: Image processing was interrupted. Select View in mIV again if needed.

state_failed.message: The processing state could not be recorded. Image processing has ended.

permission_failed.message: Site permissions could not be checked.

permission_denied.message: Access to the image site was not granted. Allow access to that site to open the image.

invalid_url.message: This image or page address is not supported. Choose an HTTP or HTTPS image.

position_failed.message: The browser viewing area could not be measured.

rule_failed.message: Preparing or finishing the image request failed.

fetch_failed.message: The image could not be retrieved. Check site permissions and the image address.

too_large.message: The image is too large to send to mIV.

unregistered.message: Browser integration is not registered. Enable browser integration in mIV preferences.

native_failed.message: A reply from mIV could not be confirmed. Any saved image remains in the browser viewing folder.

context_failed.message: Right-click position recording could not be prepared. Reopen the page if placement is inaccurate.

host_invalid_origin.message: This extension is not authorized for browser integration. Install the official extension and register integration again.

host_unsupported_version.message: The extension and mIV versions are incompatible. Update both and restart mIV.

host_invalid_request.message: The information needed to hand over the image was invalid.

host_message_too_large.message: mIV could not accept the image because the message was too large.

host_invalid_image.message: The retrieved data was not a supported image format.

host_invalid_url.message: mIV could not accept the image or page address.

host_invalid_placement.message: mIV could not accept the browser placement information.

host_registration_missing.message: Register browser integration again in mIV preferences.

host_launcher_missing.message: mIV could not be found. Reinstall mIV or unregister browser integration.

host_invalid_destination.message: The image destination cannot be used. Check the destination in mIV preferences.

host_save_failed.message: The image could not be saved. Check the destination and available space.

host_motw_failed.message: The image was saved, but its security information could not be written. It remains in the browser viewing folder.

host_launch_failed.message: The image was saved but could not be handed to mIV. Restart mIV. The image remains in the browser viewing folder.
